claims.text: Replace intravascular volume and free water orally or IV
claims.quote: Replace intravascular volume and free water orally or intravenously

claims.text: Euvolemic: free water as D5W or 0.45% saline
claims.quote: In patients with hypernatremia and euvolemia, free water can be replaced using either 5% dextrose in water or 0.45% saline.

claims.text: Hypovolemic: 0.45% saline as an alternative to 0.9% saline plus D5W; or replace ECF volume and free water separately
claims.quote: 0.45% saline can be given as an alternative to a combination of 0.9% normal saline and 5% dextrose in water to replenish sodium and free water. Alternatively, ECF volume and free water can be replaced separately

claims.text: ECF volume overload: free water as IV D5W, ± a loop diuretic
claims.quote: In patients with hypernatremia and ECF volume overload (excess total body sodium content), the free water deficit can be replaced with IV 5% dextrose in water, which can be supplemented with a loop diuretic.
